summary.headline: Astrological Questions 196–217
summary.text: Entries 196–217 in an astrological question catalogue, covering intercourse, failed questions, lunar activity and void of course, slow stars and malefics, solid signs, stellar visibility and configurations, transits and sign strength, angles, travel, marriage, grooming, clothing, purgatives, bloodletting, head treatment, loans, theft, and relocation.
